#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Reminder: Update Amazon shipping address.
Sends a desktop notification at a scheduled time.
"""

import time
import subprocess
import platform
from datetime import datetime, timedelta


def send_notification(title: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Send a cross-platform desktop notification."""
    system = platform.system()

    if system == "Linux":
        subprocess.run(["notify-send", title, message])
    elif system == "Darwin":  # macOS
        script = f'display notification "{message}" with title "{title}"'
        subprocess.run(["osascript", "-e", script])
    elif system == "Windows":
        # Uses PowerShell for Windows toast notifications
        ps_command = f"""
        [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] > $null
        $template = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::GetTemplateContent([Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastTemplateType]::ToastText02)
        $textNodes = $template.GetElementsByTagName('text')
        $textNodes.Item(0).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode('{title}')) > $null
        $textNodes.Item(1).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode('{message}')) > $null
        $toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($template)
        [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier('Address Reminder').Show($toast)
        """
        subprocess.run(["powershell", "-Command", ps_command])
    else:
        print(f"[{title}] {message}")


def schedule_reminder(target_time: datetime, title: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Wait until the target time, then send the notification."""
    now = datetime.now()
    wait_seconds = (target_time - now).total_seconds()

    if wait_seconds <= 0:
        print("⚠️  The scheduled time is in the past. Sending notification now.")
        send_notification(title, message)
        return

    print(f"⏰ Reminder scheduled for: {target_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p')}")
    print(f"   Waiting {wait_seconds:.0f} seconds ({wait_seconds / 3600:.1f} hours)...")
    print("   (Keep this script running. Press Ctrl+C to cancel.)")

    try:
        time.sleep(wait_seconds)
        send_notification(title, message)
        print("✅ Reminder sent!")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n❌ Reminder cancelled.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Schedule: tomorrow at 10:00 AM
    tomorrow_10am = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=1)).replace(
        hour=10, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0
    )

    schedule_reminder(
        target_time=tomorrow_10am,
        title="📦 Update Amazon Address",
        message=(
            "Reminder: Update your default shipping address to:\n"
            "1847 Willow Creek Rd, Austin, TX 78702, USA\n"
            "Account: maya.patel@example.com\n"
            "Go to: amazon.com/a/addresses"
        ),
    )

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Reminder: Update Amazon shipping address.
Sends a desktop notification at a scheduled time.
"""

import time
import subprocess
import platform
from datetime import datetime, timedelta


def send_notification(title: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Send a cross-platform desktop notification."""
    system = platform.system()

    if system == "Linux":
        subprocess.run(["notify-send", title, message])
    elif system == "Darwin":  # macOS
        script = f'display notification "{message}" with title "{title}"'
        subprocess.run(["osascript", "-e", script])
    elif system == "Windows":
        # Uses PowerShell for Windows toast notifications
        ps_command = f"""
        [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] > $null
        $template = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::GetTemplateContent([Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastTemplateType]::ToastText02)
        $textNodes = $template.GetElementsByTagName('text')
        $textNodes.Item(0).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode('{title}')) > $null
        $textNodes.Item(1).AppendChild($template.CreateTextNode('{message}')) > $null
        $toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($template)
        [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier('Address Reminder').Show($toast)
        """
        subprocess.run(["powershell", "-Command", ps_command])
    else:
        print(f"[{title}] {message}")


def schedule_reminder(target_time: datetime, title: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Wait until the target time, then send the notification."""
    now = datetime.now()
    wait_seconds = (target_time - now).total_seconds()

    if wait_seconds <= 0:
        print("⚠️  The scheduled time is in the past. Sending notification now.")
        send_notification(title, message)
        return

    print(f"⏰ Reminder scheduled for: {target_time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M %p')}")
    print(f"   Waiting {wait_seconds:.0f} seconds ({wait_seconds / 3600:.1f} hours)...")
    print("   (Keep this script running. Press Ctrl+C to cancel.)")

    try:
        time.sleep(wait_seconds)
        send_notification(title, message)
        print("✅ Reminder sent!")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n❌ Reminder cancelled.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Schedule: tomorrow at 10:00 AM
    tomorrow_10am = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=1)).replace(
        hour=10, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0
    )

    schedule_reminder(
        target_time=tomorrow_10am,
        title="📦 Update Amazon Address",
        message=(
            "Reminder: Update your default shipping address to:\n"
            "1847 Willow Creek Rd, Austin, TX 78702, USA\n"
            "Account: maya.patel@example.com\n"
            "Go to: amazon.com/a/addresses"
        ),
    )
```
